assertions.name: bare_knot_ratio_does_not_match
assertions.source: no bare T(2,5)/T(2,3) invariant ratio gives 2[3]_q[4]_q−1 to <5%

assertions.name: lepton_quark_ratio_tension
assertions.source: lepton gen-2/1 ratio (207) ≫ quark (20): confinement dressing

description: Tests whether m_s/m_d = 2[3]_q[4]_q−1 (≈24) derives from a bare torus-knot ratio T(2,5)/T(2,3). It does NOT (best candidate 34% off). Informative negative: the lepton gen-2/gen-1 ratio is Vol(4₁)/ℏ²≈207 (bare knot) but the quark ratio is ~20 — quark masses are confinement-dressed, so 2[3]_q[4]_q−1 is a qq̄ meson-fusion (H₃) property, not an isolated-quark-knot invariant. The [3]_q[4]_q fusion (#1436) already encodes the confined sector.

data.conclusion: m_s/m_d is confinement-dressed (meson sector), not a bare-knot ratio
